== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[We Have A Prisoner (Japanese)|We Have A Prisoner]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/157709599/9QpZ4MRoZk-WGOP80yW68w.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 90960103.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>9d490d4222cfb1d070c10ff5a45ff1188af78da1aa9af4049595a0e728d95155</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
